The *Sāsavaduka* is a textual unit within the *Paṭṭhāna*, the seventh and concluding treatise of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. The text belongs to the systematic exposition of conditional relations based on the *mātika* dyad regarding phenomena that are accompanied by or subject to cankers (*sāsava*) [SuttaCentral].

No separate translations or historical parallels are recorded for this section on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].
